title: Regenerate Xcode project with xcodegen
description: Run 'xcodegen generate' in the project root after all new Swift source files are in place. Verify the new CookbookApp/Recipes/ group and FolderSetupView.swift appear in the generated .xcodeproj. If project.yml requires an explicit source glob or group entry for the new Recipes/ subdirectory, update it first. Confirm xcodebuild can compile after regeneration.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookApp/Recipes/ source group is present in the generated project
FolderSetupView.swift is included in the generated project
New test files in CookbookAppTests/ are included
xcodebuild build (or xcodebuild test) succeeds after regeneration

handoff_summary.completed: xcodegen generate completed without errors. All new source files (CookbookApp/Recipes/*.swift, FolderSetupView.swift) and test files (CookbookAppTests/CookbookAppTests.swift) appear in the generated project.pbxproj. Build succeeds after fixing the iOS bookmark API incompatibility in RecipesFolderStore.swift.
handoff_summary.risks: RecipesFolderStore.swift now calls startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() on restore but never calls stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() for the restored URL (the store holds it for app lifetime). This is intentional for a folder store but should be reviewed if memory pressure becomes a concern.
handoff_summary.next_action: Proceed to tester agent to run the test suite against the regenerated project.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: project.pbxproj is regenerated — any sibling bead that also regenerates or manually edits the xcodeproj will conflict. Downstream agents should not modify project.pbxproj directly.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: project.yml did not need changes — the existing `path: CookbookApp` source glob recursively covers CookbookApp/Recipes/ without an explicit group entry. The `.withSecurityScope` fix was applied to the pre-existing source file rather than blocked as out-of-scope because it was the direct cause of the xcodebuild failure required by the acceptance criteria.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written in this bead. Existing CookbookAppTests/CookbookAppTests.swift is present in the project and will be exercised by the tester agent.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() is called on bookmark restore but stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() is never called on that resolved URL — acceptable for a singleton store but worth noting for future lifecycle management.

conflict_risks: project.pbxproj is regenerated — any sibling bead that also regenerates or manually edits the xcodeproj will conflict. Downstream agents should not modify project.pbxproj directly.

execution_history.summary: xcodegen generate ran successfully. CookbookApp/Recipes/ group and FolderSetupView.swift are present in the generated project.pbxproj. Fixed a pre-existing iOS incompatibility in RecipesFolderStore.swift (`.withSecurityScope` is macOS-only; replaced with `options: []` and `startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()`). xcodebuild build succeeded.
